adultGuide.title: Tabbed Folder Story Series Adult Guide
bullets: Setup: choose one story folder, add three to five paper tabs, and label each tab with a simple story series part: ____________________.
Materials: keep blank pages, pencils, tab cards, paper clips, and a folder note sheet nearby before the adult-led session begins: ____________________.
Steps: help the writer place the current page behind the right tab, reread the last page softly, then plan the next page on paper: ____________________.
Safety: keep every name, place, and problem inside a made-up story world, and do not place child work online or ask for private details: ____________________.
Continuity: use the tab cards to track who is in the story series, what changed, and what the next page should remember: ____________________.
Reset: when the session ends, tuck loose pages into the story folder, mark the next tab to use, and write one adult reminder for later: ____________________.

seriesRoutines.title: Tab Check-In
adultSteps: The adult opens the story folder and asks which tab holds the current page: ____________________.
The child points to the tab and names the made-up story series part: ____________________.
The adult reads the last two paper notes under that tab: ____________________.
The child chooses one note that must stay true on the next page: ____________________.
seriesRoutines.familyLine: Today this story folder tab needs to remember: ____________________.

seriesRoutines.title: Last Page Echo
adultSteps: The adult reads the last page from the story folder while the child follows with a finger: ____________________.
The child circles one pretend character, place, or object that should return: ____________________.
The adult asks what changed on that last page: ____________________.
The child starts the next page by echoing one small detail without copying the whole line: ____________________.
seriesRoutines.familyLine: The next page will echo this detail from the last page: ____________________.

seriesRoutines.title: Series Thread Card
adultSteps: The adult hands over one tab card for the story series thread: ____________________.
The child writes the thread in a short phrase, such as lost key, moon map, or tiny boat: ____________________.
The adult asks how that thread appears on the current page: ____________________.
The child writes one next page reminder on the same tab card: ____________________.
seriesRoutines.familyLine: The story series thread we are carrying forward is: ____________________.

seriesRoutines.title: Next Page Bridge
adultSteps: The adult asks what the current page leaves unfinished in the pretend story: ____________________.
The child says one gentle question the next page can answer: ____________________.
The adult writes the question on a tab card and places it before the blank page: ____________________.
The child begins the next page with one sentence that answers or follows the question: ____________________.
seriesRoutines.familyLine: Our next page will answer or follow this question: ____________________.

seriesRoutines.title: Folder Order Walk
adultSteps: The adult spreads the story folder pages in order beside the tabs: ____________________.
The child taps each page and says what happened there in one short phrase: ____________________.
The adult asks which page the new page should follow: ____________________.
The child places the new page behind the right tab and writes the page label: ____________________.

seriesRoutines.title: Gentle Series Reset
adultSteps: The adult asks which page is done enough for today and places it in the story folder: ____________________.
The child chooses one tab card that needs a reminder for the next session: ____________________.
The adult writes a simple restart line, such as begin with the map or ask about the lantern: ____________________.
The child closes the folder and names the next page idea in one paper note: ____________________.
seriesRoutines.familyLine: Next time, this story series can restart with: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Home Tab Label Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: help choose a clear tab label for the current story folder section: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: put the new page behind this tab: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Returning Detail Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: ask which pretend detail should return from the last page: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.childLine: Child: the detail I will bring back is: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: use that detail in one new sentence: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Character Thread Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: point to the tab card that tracks one made-up character: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.childLine: Child: this character still wants or needs: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: show one tiny action from that character: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Place Reminder Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: ask which pretend place should stay the same across pages: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.childLine: Child: my story place reminder is: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: add one matching place detail: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Object Carryover Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: help find one made-up object that should carry into the next page: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.childLine: Child: the object I am carrying forward is: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: let the object help or change something: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Question Bridge Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: write one gentle story question on a tab card: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.childLine: Child: my next page question is: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: answer the question with one story action: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Page Order Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: lay out the story folder pages and ask where the new page belongs: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: write the page label before starting: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Same World Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: ask what rule or detail makes this story world feel connected: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.childLine: Child: one thing that stays true in my story series is: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: keep that rule or detail in the new scene: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Small Change Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: ask what small change should happen next without losing the story thread: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.childLine: Child: the small change I choose is: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: write the change after one familiar detail: ____________________.

takeHomeSeriesSlips.title: Restart Note Slip
takeHomeSeriesSlips.adultLine: Adult: write one restart note before closing the story folder: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.childLine: Child: next time I want to begin with: ____________________.
takeHomeSeriesSlips.nextStepLine: Next page: read this note first, then write one new line: ____________________.
